title: Production Manager
description:
The ideal candidate will own the entire production process. They will strategize with other internal teams to ensure operational excellence. The will also run quality assessment to ensure customer satisfaction.
 



  





 1\. To lead production planning from the unit’s objectives and ensure that production happens on time and as per plan
 



 2\. To ensure that volume production targets during season and non season is as per plans
 



 3\. To plan the resources for production in relation to costs and productivity norms
 



 5\. Planning of all equipment's maintenance schedules to ensure uninterrupted production.
 



 6\. Ensuring all equipment's in the line are operated as per the rated capacity, minimal break downs \& good Mechanical Efficiency
 



 7\. To ensure that the quality of the beverage manufactured is as per standards through establishment and review of quality systems.
 



 8\. To reach the product and package indices as per targets and to ensure that quality systems are maintained
 



 10\. To maintain a complete record of all the production reports.
 



 11\. To Create and maintain various MIS reports
 



 12\. Effectively implemented the preventive maintenance schedule on interval basis like \-daily, weekly, and monthly and annually to maintain the health of equipment perfect\- A3 Speed, Straw Applicator CP\- 70
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics
* 10\+ years of production experience in handling PET lines or similar Machines
* Strong organizational and managerial skills
